(2) The toddler looks into the open tin, which appears empty. He uses his right hand to pretend-pick something from the air and puts it in his mouth, chewing. The adult's hand moves nearby. A white teepee tent is visible in the background. (3) The toddler continues the action of moving his hand from the tin to his mouth. He looks up and around the room with wide eyes. A woman with dark hair and a white t-shirt enters the frame, interacting with the child and the tin. (4) The toddler closes the lid of the tin and puts it on the floor. He looks toward the woman and then waves his right hand toward the camera. A dark circular vignette closes over the scene as the toddler continues waving.
